infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.urlText: Chatswood diversions for special event
infoLinks.content:
From 4am Saturday 21 February until 9pm Sunday 22 February, route 115 & 120 services will be diverting and using alternative stops while road closures are in place for Lunar New Year celebrations in Chatswood.
 
Services will be diverting away from Victoria Avenue in both directions via Penshurst Street, Ashley Street and Anderson Street. All stops on Victoria Avenue between Anderson Street and Penshurst Street will be missed.
 
A free shuttle bus operated by the city council will be running along Victoria Avenue to take passengers close to the Chatswood CBD.
 
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.
 
Missed stops:
  • Victoria Avenue after Penshurst Street (206723)
  • Mashman Park, Victoria Avenue (206724)
  • Victoria Avenue opposite Chatswood Chase Sydney (206726)
  • Westfield Chatswood, Victoria Avenue (206788)
  • The Concourse, Victoria Avenue (206730)
  • Chatswood Chase Sydney, Victoria Avenue (206731)
  • Victoria Avenue at Baldry Street (206732)
  • Victoria Avenue at Macquarie Street (206733)
  • Victoria Avenue at Royal Street (206734)

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Macarthur, Glenfield and Fairfield, and some trains between Leppington and East Hills
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 28 February and Sunday 1 March
  • Buses replace trains between Macarthur, Glenfield and Fairfield.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Leppington or Revesby and the City via the Airport.
  • T8 trains continue to run between Sydenham and the City Circle, some to a changed timetable.

  • From 9.40pm Saturday to 3am Sunday, buses also replace trains between Leppington and East Hills.
  • Trains run between East Hills and the City, to a changed timetable.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
11T8 Campbelltown, Minto, Ingleburn, Glenfield and return
79T2 Macarthur, all stations to Fairfield and return
80T2 Liverpool, all stations to Fairfield and return
9.40pm Saturday to 3am Sunday
22T2 Leppington, all stations to East Hills and return
74T8 Macarthur, all stations to Glenfield, then express to East Hills and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.  

Missed stops:

infoLinks.urlText: Lakemba diversions for Lakemba Nights Market
infoLinks.content:
From 4pm until 4.30am every Thursday to Sunday night between 19 February and 15 March buses will be diverting and missing stops on Haldon St while road closures are in place for the Lakemba Nights during Ramadan event. 
 
Route 946 buses will divert around a section of Haldon St via The Boulevarde, Quigg St and Canterbury Rd in both directions. Stops between The Boulevarde and Canterbury Rd will be missed. 
 
Catch buses towards Roselands from: 
  • St Therese's Primary School, Lakemba St (Stop ID 219585) or 
  • Canterbury Rd before Dennis St (Stop ID 219517).  
 
Catch buses towards Bankstown from: 
  • Quigg St S before Gillies St (Temporary bus stop) or
  • Canterbury Rd at Legge St (Stop ID 2196258). 
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. For more transport information, see the Lakemba Nights event page. 
 
Missed bus stops: 
  • Haldon St at Gillies Ave (Stop ID 219594) 
  • Haldon St at Grace Ave (Stop ID 219595) 
  • Al Hikma College, Haldon St (Stop ID 219596) 
  • Haldon St after Canterbury Rd (Stop ID 219580) 
  • Haldon St before Hall Pde (Stop ID 219581) 
  • Haldon St opp Gillies Ave (Stop ID 219582)

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Bardwell Park
infoLinks.content:
Access to Bardwell Park Station is via temporary stairs on the eastern side of Hartill-Law Avenue to enable the demolition of the existing station stairs and construction of new stairs and a lift on the western side of Hartill-Law Avenue. Allow extra time to safely cross the road at the signalised pedestrian crossing at the corner of Hartill-Law Avenue and Slade Road.

Please also note that there are no public toilets available at this station until further notice.

infoLinks.urlText: Changes to school bus services impacted by Waterfall Way closure
infoLinks.content:
Some school buses are not running due to the closure of Waterfall Way west of Bellingen due to a landslip.  
As an interim solution for school students in the Dorrigo and Bellingen area, a fleet of minibuses will operate school services via the detour on Summervilles Road.
From Monday 9 February, a phased approach has commenced for school bus services. Families should stay abreast of communication being distributed via their schools.
Sign up for SMS updates about interim bus service cancellations
Inclement weather and road conditions have the potential to prevent interim bus movements on the detour route and cancel services.
Transport has set up an SMS service to notify families of cancellations of services. Opt in to receive SMS via this link.
Routes affected:
  • S110
  • S125
  • S126
  • S127
  • S887

infoLinks.urlText: Lakemba diversions for Lakemba Nights Market
infoLinks.content:
From 4pm until 4.30am every Thursday to Sunday night between 19 February and 15 March buses will be diverting and missing stops on Haldon St while road closures are in place for the Lakemba Nights during Ramadan event. 
 
SW1 and SW2 Southwest Link buses and Route N40 buses will divert around a section of The Boulevarde via King Georges Rd, Lakemba St and Haldon St in both directions. 
  • Southwest Link buses towards Sydenham and N40 buses to Town Hall will pick up from St Therese's Primary School, Lakemba St (219585)
  • Southwest Link buses towards Bankstown and N40 buses to East Hills will pick up from Lakemba St opp Therese's Primary School (219591) 
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. For more transport information, see the Lakemba Nights event page. 
 
Missed bus stops: 
  • Lakemba Station, The Boulevarde Stand D (2195118) 
  • Lakemba Station, The Boulevarde, Stand E (219527) 
  • The Boulevarde after King Georges Rd (219526)

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and Darlinghurst diversions for Mardi Gras Parade
infoLinks.content:
On Saturday 28 February buses will be diverting due to major road closures in the Sydney CBD, Darlinghurst and Moore Park for the Sydney Mardi Gras Parade
 
From 3:30pm to 2.30am services will start and end in Kings Cross and will not run between Kings Cross and Central. Buses from Millers Point will end trips at Kings Cross Station, Darlinghurst Rd, Stand B (Stop ID 201112). Services towards Millers Point will start trips from Kings Cross Station, Darlinghurst Rd, Stand A (Stop ID 201111). Catch trains to continue your trip between Kings Cross and Central.
 
Check signs at stops for alternative bus stop locations and allow extra travel time.

For more details on transport options and service changes, visit the Sydney Gay & Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade event page.

infoLinks.content:

  • From 8am to 1pm, buses replace trains between Newcastle Interchange and Telarah or Muswellbrook.
  • The 08:29 Newcastle Interchange to Dungog will not run. Catch the 08:48 Newcastle Interchange to Telarah train and change at Maitland for a bus towards Dungog.
  • Buses also replace the 10:02 Dungog to Newcastle Interchange service.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
1HU Newcastle Interchange, all stations to Telarah and return
4HU Maitland, all stations to Dungog (in that direction only)
7HU Warabrook Station to University shuttle bus
15HU Maitland, all stations to Muswellbrook (in that direction only)
19HU Dungog, all stations to Maitland, Victoria Street, all stations to Beresfield, Warabrook, all stations to Newcastle Interchange (in that direction only)

  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.

infoLinks.urlText: Valla Beach Road diversion – bus service changes
infoLinks.content:
From 12 January 2026, roadworks at Valla Beach Road will require buses on routes 358, 360 and 360X between Macksville, Coffs Harbour and Bellingen to divert.

The diversion will add time to all buses operating to/from Valla Beach. Some other timetables will also be adjusted due to this diversion.

No bus will depart earlier than its normal time.

The changes are expected to be in place for approximately two weeks.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and Darlinghurst diversions for Mardi Gras Parade
infoLinks.content:
Early morning on Sunday 1 March buses will be diverting due to major road closures in the Sydney CBD, Darlinghurst and Moore Park for the Sydney Mardi Gras Parade.

From first service until 2:30am services will divert via Cleveland St, Chalmers St, Randle St into Elizabeth St then as normal. Services leaving the city will divert via Cleveland St and Anzac Pde.

Check signs at stops for alternative bus stop locations and allow extra travel time.

For more details on transport options and service changes, visit the Sydney Gay & Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Lakemba diversions for Lakemba Nights Market
infoLinks.content:
From 4pm until 4.30am every Thursday to Sunday night between 19 February and 15 March buses will be diverting and missing stops on Haldon St while road closures are in place for the Lakemba Nights during Ramadan event. 
 
Route 450 buses will divert around a section of Haldon St via The Boulevarde, Quigg St and Canterbury Rd in both directions. Stops between The Boulevarde and Canterbury Rd will be missed. 
 
Catch buses towards Hurstville from: 
  • Quigg St south before Gillies St (Temporary bus stop) 
  • Benaroon Rd at Lakemba St (219266) 
  • Canterbury Rd after Remly St (2196152). 
     
    Catch buses towards Strathfield from: 
  • Canterbury Rd after Willeroo St (219532) 
  • Benaroon Rd after Lakemba St (219586) 
  • Quigg St south before Gillies St (Temporary bus stop)  
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. For more transport information, see the Lakemba Nights event page. 
 
Missed bus stops: 
  • Haldon St at Gillies Ave (219594) 
  • Haldon St at Grace Ave (219595) 
  • Al Hikma College, Haldon St (219596) 
  • Haldon St after Canterbury Rd (219580) 
  • Haldon St before Hall Pde (219581) 
  • Haldon St opp Gillies Ave (219582) 
  • Lakemba St at Barremma Rd (219120) 
  • Lakemba Station, Haldon St, Stand B (219514) 
  • Lakemba Station, Haldon St, Stand A (219515) 
  • Lakemba St at Moreton St (219590) 
  • Lakemba St opp Therese's Primary School (219591)

infoLinks.urlText: Camden diversions for Festival
infoLinks.content:
From 5am until 5pm on Saturday 21 February, route 890C services will be diverting, missing stops and using temporary stops while road closures are in place for Spin Our Rock ‘N Roll Festival in Camden. 

Services to Camden will end trips at a temporary bus stop on Mitchell St opp Camden Public School (2570489).  

Services leaving Camden will starts trips at Camden Public School, Mitchell St (2570269) and stop at the temporary bus stop on Elizabeth Street before Argyle Street.  

Stops on John Street will be missed in both directions.  

Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.  

Missed stops: 
  • St Paul's Catholic Primary School, John St (2570310) 
  • John St before Argyle St (257011) 
  • Argyle St at Elizabeth St (257015)

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Cronulla and Sutherland, and some trains between Hurstville and Waterfall
infoLinks.content:
Monday 23 to Thursday 26 February
  • Nightly from 9.40pm to 2.30am, buses replace trains between Cronulla and Sutherland.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Waterfall, Sutherland and Bondi Junction.

  • Monday and Tuesday, some trains make extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • Trackwork on the City Circle may also affect how you travel.

  • Friday from 12.20am to 2.30am, buses replace trains between Cronulla and Hurstville, and some trains from Hurstville to Waterfall.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
33T4 Cronulla, all stations to Sutherland and return
Friday morning
41T4 Hurstville, all stations to Sutherland, express to Waterfall
42T4 Cronulla, all stations to Sutherland, express Hurstville and return
43T4 Sutherland, all stations to Hurstville and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and Darlinghurst diversions for Mardi Gras Parade
infoLinks.content:
On Saturday 28 February buses will be diverting due to major road closures in the Sydney CBD, Darlinghurst and Moore Park for the Sydney Mardi Gras Parade. The Moore Park Busway will be closed and buses will run to and from the city as normal but use stops on Anzac Pde instead of the busway. Buses will start and end at Central instead of Museum.
Services will end at Stand D and pickup from Stand C.

Buses will be diverting via Anzac Pde, Cleveland St, Crown St, Foveaux St, Elizabeth St, Hay St, Pitt St and Eddy Ave dropping off at Stand D on Eddy Ave. Services leaving the city will pick up from Eddy Ave Stand C and will travel via Albion St, Crown St, Cleveland St, Anzac Pde, Alison Rd then as normal.

Check signs at stops for alternative bus stop locations and allow extra travel time.

For more details on transport options and service changes, visit the Sydney Gay & Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Allow extra travel time as Kiss and Ride upgrade is underway at Leppington Station
infoLinks.content:
Road work is underway to improve the Kiss and Ride zone north of Leppington Station.
  • A reduced speed limit of 40km/h will be in place on the approach to Leppington Station from both directions.
  • A temporary Kiss and Ride zone is available in the commuter car park south of Leppington Station.
  • Access to the multi-storey commuter car park will remain open.
  • Work will take place between 7am to 6pm, Monday to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays.
Please allow extra travel time. View the project page for more information on the upgrade.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and Darlinghurst diversions for Mardi Gras Parade
infoLinks.content:
On Saturday 28 February buses will be diverting due to major road closures in the Sydney CBD, Darlinghurst and Moore Park for the Sydney Mardi Gras Parade.

From 5pm until last service buses between the city and Marrickville will be diverting around Oxford St and Flinders St closures in Darlinghurst via Lang Rd, Cook Rd and Moore Park Rd in both directions. All stops on Crown St and Oxford St will be missed in both directions.

Check signs at stops for alternative bus stop locations and allow extra travel time.

For more details on transport options and service changes, visit the Sydney Gay & Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Burwood diversions for special event
infoLinks.content:
From 6am Saturday 21 February until 2am Sunday 22 February, route 410 & 464 services will be diverting missing stops and using different stops while road closures are in place for Lunar New Year celebrations in Burwood. 

Services travelling towards Macquarie Park/Mortlake will divert away from a section of Burwood Road via Nicholson Street, Conder Street and Railway Parade to return to route on Burwood Road.  
 
Services travelling towards Hurstville/Ashfield will divert via Victoria Street, Shaftesbury Road and Clarence Street to return to route on Burwood Road. An extra stop will be made on Clarence St at Burwood Rd (213443). 
 
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Glenfield, Sydenham and Central via the Airport
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 7 and Sunday 8 March  
  • Buses replace trains between Glenfield, Sydenham and Central via the Airport.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern between:
    • Macarthur and Central, platforms 1-14 via Granville or Regents Park
    • Sydenham and Bondi Junction.
  • From the Airport, change at Central for T4 Eastern Suburbs & Illawarra or South Coast Line trains, not Wolli Creek.
Weekend trackwork on other lines may also affect how you travel
  • City Circle: Trains do not run around the City Circle. For travel to Circular Quay, St James or Museum use light rail or local buses.
  • M1 North West & Bankstown Line: Metro services do not run between Sydenham and Tallawong.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.

infoLinks.urlText: Museum Station closed for Mardi Gras Parade
infoLinks.content:
From 5pm Saturday 28 February until 4am Sunday 1 March, Museum Station will be closed and trains will not stop at the station during this time for the safety of large crowds gathering for the Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade.
 
Use Central, St James, Martin Place or Town Hall stations instead.
 
Note:

Pedestrian crossing of the parade route on Oxford St and Flinders St will be available until 6:30pm before the event gets underway. After 6:30pm you won’t be able to cross the road. Make sure you head towards your preferred viewing side of the parade early to secure a spot.
  • Northern side parade viewing (Darlinghurst): Use Town Hall, St James, Martin Place or Kings Cross station
  • Southern side parade viewing (Surry Hills): Use Central station for access to the southern side. 
For more details on transport options and service changes, visit the Sydney Gay & Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and Darlinghurst diversions for Mardi Gras Parade
infoLinks.content:
On Saturday 28 February buses will be diverting due to major road closures in the Sydney CBD, Darlinghurst and Moore Park for the Sydney Mardi Gras Parade. The Moore Park Busway will be closed, buses will run to and from the city as normal but use stops on Anzac Pde instead of the busway. Buses to the city will be diverting via Anzac Pde, Cleveland St, Crown St, Foveaux St then as normal. Services leaving the city will divert via Albion St, Crown St, Cleveland St, Anzac Pde then as normal.
 
Stops on Albion St, Oxford St, Museum and Flinders St will be missed in both directions.

Check signs at stops for alternative bus stop locations and allow extra travel time.

For more details on transport options and service changes, visit the Sydney Gay & Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Lithgow and Mount Victoria
infoLinks.content:
Monday 16 to Friday 20 February
  • Buses replace trains between Lithgow and Mount Victoria.
  • Trains run between Mount Victoria and Central, some to a changed timetable.
  • Bathurst trains run to a changed timetable between Bathurst and Lithgow or Central.

  • Friday from 8.50pm, buses replace trains from Lithgow to Blacktown.
  • The last train to Central leaves Mount Victoria at 19:56, arriving Central at 22:17.
  • From 10.40pm, buses replace trains from Blacktown to Lithgow.
  • The last train to the Blue Mountains leaves Central at 21:09, arriving Mount Victoria 23:30.
  • T1 Western Line trains run between the City and St Marys, to a changed timetable. Change at Blacktown for buses to Blue Mountains Line stations.
  • If travelling to Lithgow to connect with NSW TrainLink Regional Coaches call 132 232 to confirm departure times.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
32BM Lithgow, all stations to Mount Victoria and return (bypassing Bell)
Friday night
5BM Katoomba, all stations to Penrith, express to Blacktown and return
53BM Lithgow, all stations to Katoomba, Springwood, Blaxland and Blacktown and return (bypassing Bell)
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Hurstville diversions for special event
infoLinks.content:
From 12.01am until 11.59pm on Saturday 21 February, route 947 services will be diverting and using alternative stops while road closures are in place for Lunar New Year celebrations in Hurstville. 

Services travelling to Hurstville will divert into Barratt Street and end trips at Hurstville Station, Barratt St, Stand E (2220329). 
 
Services leaving Hurstville will start trips at Westfield Hurstville, Cross St (2220301) and divert via Crofts Avenue, Barratt Street, Dora Street,
Queens Road and The Ave to return to route on Forest Road. An additional stop will be made at Hurstville Station, Barratt St, Stand E (2220329). 
 
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.  
 
Missed stops: 
  • Hurstville Station, Stand A (2220328) 
  • Westfield Hurstville, Forest Rd (222023)

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Bankstown and Lidcombe
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 4 and Thursday 5 March 
  • Nightly from 9.10pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Bankstown and Lidcombe.
  • Buses also replace T3 Liverpool & Inner West Line trains between Liverpool and Lidcombe.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
9T3 Liverpool, all stations to Lidcombe and return
8T6 Bankstown, all stations to Lidcombe and return​
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Chatswood diversions for special event
infoLinks.content:
From 4am Saturday 21 February until 9pm Sunday 22 February, route 275 services will be diverting and using missing stops while road closures are in place for Lunar New Year celebrations in Chatswood. 
 
Services will be diverting away from Victoria Avenue in both directions via Penshurst Street, Ashley Street and Anderson Street. All stops on Victoria Avenue, Anderson Street and Penshurst Street will be missed. 
 
A free shuttle bus operated by the city council will be running along Victoria Avenue to take passengers close to the Chatswood CBD.  
 
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time. 
 
Missed stops  
  • Victoria Avenue after Penshurst Street (206723)  
  • Mashman Park, Victoria Avenue (206724)  
  • Victoria Avenue at Olga Street (206725)  
  • Victoria Avenue opposite Chatswood Chase Sydney (206726)  
  • Westfield Chatswood, Victoria Avenue (206788)  
  • Anderson Street at Endeavour Street (206719)  
  • The Concourse, Victoria Avenue (206730)  
  • Chatswood Chase Sydney, Victoria Avenue (206731)  
  • Victoria Avenue at Baldry Street (206732)  
  • Victoria Avenue at Macquarie Street (206733)  
  • Victoria Avenue at Royal Street (206734)

infoLinks.urlText: Route 850 is changing from 31 August
infoLinks.content:
• From Sunday 31 August, Route 850 services will no longer operate via Gregory Hills Drive to Gregory Hills Town Centre, instead it will operate via Camden Valley Way providing customers with a more efficient trip.
  • Alternative bus routes operating via Gregory Hills Drive and Town Centre include:
    • For travel to Minto, passengers can travel to Campbelltown Station via Route 840 and change to the T8 South and Airport Line.
    • For travel between Oran Park and Gregory Hills, passengers can use bus route 840.
    • For travel to Narellan passengers can use bus route 841. Timetable changes will also affect this route.
  • Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.

infoLinks.content:

Services towards the City will be diverting via Raglan St and Elizabeth St. Services away from the City will be diverting via Chalmers St and Cleveland St. Stops will be missed on Redfern St in both directions. Use alternative stops on Regent St or Chalmers St instead.

Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. 

Stops missed:

  • Redfern St at George St (stop ID 201620)

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and Darlinghurst diversions for Mardi Gras Parade
infoLinks.content:
On Saturday 28 February buses will be diverting due to major road closures in the Sydney CBD, Darlinghurst and Moore Park for the Sydney Mardi Gras Parade. Services will divert around Oxford St through Darlinghurst via Kings Cross. All stops on Oxford St between Hyde Park and Flinders St will be missed. Services to the city will divert via Darlinghurst Rd, Craigend St, William St, Park St, Elizabeth St then as normal. Services leaving the city will travel via Elizabeth St, Park St, left William St, Kings Cross Rd, Victoria St, Oxford St then as normal.

All stops on Oxford St between Hyde Park and Flinders St will be missed. Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations.

For more details on transport options and service changes, visit the Sydney Gay & Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Lakemba diversions for Lakemba Nights Market
infoLinks.content:
From 4pm until 4.30am every Thursday to Sunday night between 19 February and 15 March buses will be diverting and missing stops on Haldon St while road closures are in place for the Lakemba Nights during Ramadan event. 
 
Route 942 buses will divert around a section of Haldon St via The Boulevarde, Quigg St and Canterbury Rd in both directions. Stops between The Boulevarde and Canterbury Rd will be missed. 
 
Catch buses towards Campsie from: 
  • St Therese's Primary School, Lakemba St (219585) or  
  • Lakemba St at Barremma Rd (2195120) 
  • Leylands Pde after Peel St (219246) 
Catch buses towards Lugarno from: 
  • Lakemba St opp Therese's Primary School (219591) 
  • The Boulevarde at Moreton St (2195114) 
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. For more transport information, see the Lakemba Nights event page. 
 
Missed bus stops: 
  • The Boulevarde at Dennis St (2195112) 
  • The Boulevarde opp Dennis St (2195113) 
  • The Boulevarde after Moreton St (2195115) 
  • Lakemba Station, Haldon St, Stand B (219514) 
  • Lakemba Station, Haldon St, Stand A (219515) 
  • Peel St at Bridge Rd (219250)

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Macarthur, Glenfield and Fairfield. Trains run to a changed stopping pattern; you may need to change services
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 28 February and Sunday 1 March
  • Buses replace trains between Macarthur, Glenfield and Fairfield.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern between Leppington and the City via the Airport, and between Fairfield and Richmond. Change at Parramatta for trains to the City via Granville.
  • Inner West trains run between Homebush or Ashfield and the City.
  • Buses also replace T3 trains between Liverpool and Lidcombe via Regents Park.

  • From 9.40pm Saturday to 3am Sunday, buses also replace trains between Leppington and East Hills.
  • Trains run between East Hills and the City, to a changed timetable.

  • Sunday from 4am to 1.20pm, Inner West trains run to a changed timetable between Homebush and the City.
  • T9 Northern Line trains make an extra stop at Ashfield.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
11T8 Campbelltown, Minto, Ingleburn, Glenfield and return
79T2 Macarthur, all stations to Fairfield and return
80T2 Liverpool, all stations to Fairfield and return

Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Burwood diversions for special event
infoLinks.content:
From 6am Saturday 21 February until 2am Sunday 22 February, route 418 & 420 services will be diverting, missing stops and using different stops while road closures are in place for Lunar New Year celebrations in Burwood. 
 
Services travelling to Burwood will divert away from a section of Burwood Road via Clarence Street, Shaftesbury Road and Railway Parade to return to route on Burwood Road. Extra stops will be made on Clarence St at Burwood Rd (213436) and at Burwood Station, Burwood Rd, Stand G (213453). 
 
Services leaving Burwood will divert via Victoria Street, Shaftesbury Road and Clarence Street to return to route on Burwood Road. An extra stop will be made on Clarence St at Burwood Rd (213443).

content:

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route

Replacement buses

infoLinks.urlText: Service changes for SailGP event
infoLinks.content:
Some ferries will be affected by exclusion zones on the Sydney Harbour, speed limit reductions and wash restrictions around Shark Island for the Sail GP event. 
F1 Manly, F7 Double Bay and F9 Watsons Bay ferries will run to a changed timetable and may experience delays between 1pm and 4pm on Friday 27 February, and from 4.30pm to 7.30pm on Saturday 28 February and Sunday 1 March. 
Listen to announcements and follow the directions of transport staff. Consider the other transport options available. Allow extra travel time if you're planning to catch a ferry on affected routes to vantage points and plan your trip ahead of time using the Trip Planner. 
For more information on the event see the Sail GP event page.

infoLinks.urlText: First Ave and Second Ave Bridge Crossing bus diversions
infoLinks.content:
From Friday 26 September until further notice, the following stops will be closed for route 942 services due to First Ave and Second Ave Bridge Crossing works.
 
Stops affected:
  • Rudd Park, First Ave (219144) and First Ave at Clarence St (219145) will be closed.
    - Alternative bus stop for 942 Lugarno services: Seventh Ave at First Ave (219489)
  • Rudd Park, Clarence St (219147) will be closed.
    - Alternative bus stop for 942 Lugarno services: Omaha St at Lincoln St (219155)
  • Baltimore St after Indiana Pl (219138) and Clarence St opp Rudd Park (219140) will be closed.
    - Alternative bus stop for 942 Campsie services: Omaha St opp Lincoln St (219156)
  • Clarence St at First Ave (219142), First Ave opp Rudd Park (219473) and First Ave at Seventh Ave (219474) will be closed.
    - Alternative bus stop for 942 Campsie services: Seventh Ave at First St (219491)
